parsed.summary: The PR adds a new method `set_paths` to `ContourSet`, but it does not address the functional completeness or behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The PR does not provide a complete solution to the problem. It only adds a new method without modifying the existing workaround in Cartopy.
The PR introduces a new method that may break existing behavior in Cartopy or other parts of the project that rely on the current implementation.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the functionality of the new method `set_paths`.
